Lina (PM): Quick UX question — we're iterating on the 'Simulate traffic' toggle and the empty-state copy for the routing preview. Current copy: "Simulate traffic (preview)" feels vague. Thoughts? Matt (Design): +1, that label is ambiguous. Users ask: simulate what? suggest: "Run preview simulation" or "Simulate policy traffic". Also thinking about persisted state vs session-only. Ana (Frontend): Prefer shorter labels for toolbars. What about "Preview simulation" with a tooltip: "Run synthetic traffic against this policy; results are ephemeral"? Tooltip helps with the ephemeral bit. Maya (A11y): Need to ensure the toggle has an accessible name and state. Propose aria-label: "Run policy simulation, off" / "Run policy simulation, on" and aria-describedby linking to the tooltip text. Also keyboard users need explicit focus styles on the toggle and the sim results panel should be announced when finished. Sam (Research): From testing, users expect an explanation when simulation can't run (e.g., empty rules or circular priorities). We should show a concise inline message: "Simulation paused — add at least one active rule" rather than a generic error. Matt (Design): Draft microcopy options for the inline states: - Empty: "No rules to simulate — add rules to preview traffic." - Invalid order: "Simulation blocked — one or more rules conflict with priority ordering. Check rule priorities." - Running: "Simulation running — results update below." Ana (Frontend): Implementation notes: we need 1) toggle aria-label, 2) aria-live=polite region for results, 3) explicit IDs for error banners. For the reorder handle we should include aria-label like: "Drag to reorder rule (position {i} of {n})". Example: `aria-label="Reorder rule 3 of 5"`. Maya (A11y): +1 to that handle label. Also ensure the drag handle is reachable via keyboard (space to pick up, arrow keys to move) and SR announces new position. Add small announcement copy: "Rule moved to position {k} of {n}". Lina (PM): Nice. Can we pick final microcopy for the toggle and the empty-state this sprint? I like "Preview simulation" (label) + tooltip "Run synthetic traffic against this policy; results are temporary" and empty-state: "No rules to simulate — add a rule to see preview results." Ana (Frontend): I can wire that up. Will also add the aria labels and the polite live region. Posting a quick snippet for the toggle: ```
Run synthetic traffic against this policy; results are temporary.
``` Matt (Design): I'll update the mock and the tooltip copy in Figma. Sam — can you validate the wording in the next participant session? Sam (Research): Yep, I'll slot it into Thursday's sessions. devbot: deploy-preview created for branch feature/sim-copy-aria — netlify.app/preview-232 :rocket: Lina (PM): Awesome. Follow-ups: Maya will write a short A11y checklist, Ana will implement, Matt will update mock, Sam will test. I'll schedule a quick 15m sync if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
